emphasis_points: Convey internal storage capacity and compartment organization through concrete physical layout details (number of doors, shelves, hanging rails, internal drawers) rather than generic spaciousness claims.
Highlight door mechanism (hinged, sliding) and accessibility in relation to room circulation and wall clearance.
Emphasize exterior finish and structural joinery that maintain a cohesive presence along the bedroom wall.
avoid_list: Do not state exact volumetric capacity or storage counts unless explicitly given in source data.
Do not use 'walk-in' language or imply room-scale storage unless explicitly specified as such.
Do not invent internal organizer features (such as tie racks or jewelry trays) absent from specifications.
Do not use 'bedroom wall' or close variants — describe concrete product attributes instead.
tone_notes: Practical and structured, grounded in verifiable configuration details, spatial ergonomics, and daily storage utility rather than a fixed adjective set.
